SELECT o.org_id, o.legal_name,
       SUM(CAST(arb.remaining_balance AS REAL)) AS total_remaining_undisbursed
FROM organization o
JOIN award a ON a.org_id = o.org_id
JOIN award_remaining_balance arb ON arb.award_id = a.award_id
GROUP BY o.org_id, o.legal_name
ORDER BY o.org_id
tasks.unresolved_handling: All five awards have established remaining_balance rows in award_remaining_balance; summed per organization with no missing or uninterpreted balance values.

-- organization for A-101
SELECT o.* FROM organization o
JOIN award a ON a.org_id = o.org_id
WHERE a.award_id = 'A-101';

-- all awards of that organization
SELECT a.* FROM award a
JOIN award a0 ON a0.org_id = a.org_id
WHERE a0.award_id = 'A-101'
ORDER BY a.award_id;

-- all disbursements on those awards
SELECT d.* FROM disbursement d
JOIN award a ON d.award_id = a.award_id
JOIN award a0 ON a0.org_id = a.org_id
WHERE a0.award_id = 'A-101'
ORDER BY d.award_id, d.date
tasks.unresolved_handling: A-101 links to ORG-MEADOW in award; org linkage, sibling awards, and disbursements are fully established WORLD rows.

-- Active remaining total (WORLD award_status_label + award_remaining_balance)
SELECT SUM(CAST(arb.remaining_balance AS REAL)) AS active_remaining_total
FROM award_status_label asl
JOIN award_remaining_balance arb ON arb.award_id = asl.award_id
WHERE asl.status_label = 'Active';

-- Unresolved siblings of Active awards (PURPOSE failures on award status)
WITH active_awards AS (
  SELECT a.award_id, a.org_id
  FROM award a
  JOIN award_status_label asl ON asl.award_id = a.award_id
  WHERE asl.status_label = 'Active'
),
siblings AS (
  SELECT aa.award_id AS active_award_id, s.award_id AS sibling_award_id,
         s.org_id, s.program, s.amount, s.status_code
  FROM active_awards aa
  JOIN award s ON s.org_id = aa.org_id AND s.award_id != aa.award_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT sb.*
FROM siblings sb
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM purpose_requirement_failure prf
  WHERE prf.relation_name = 'award'
    AND prf.affected_identity = sb.sibling_award_id
    AND prf.failure_kind IN ('UNINTERPRETED', 'EXPLICIT_UNRESOLVED')
)
ORDER BY sb.sibling_award_id
tasks.unresolved_handling: Active status taken from WORLD award_status_label (codes A mapped to Active via status_legend_entry). Active remaining total sums only those two awards (15000 + 0). Sibling A-103 of Active A-101 has established Closed status and is excluded. Sibling A-105 of Active A-102 carries PURPOSE-scoped UNINTERPRETED failures (status code H absent from status_legend_entry); listed separately and not folded into the Active total.
